name: Rulesync
summary: Node.js CLI that generates AI coding tool config files (rules, MCP, commands, skills) from one unified source.
description: A Node.js CLI tool that generates configuration files for many AI development tools from unified AI rule files. It supports rules, ignore files, MCP, commands, subagents, skills, hooks and permissions, can import existing per-tool configurations and export them to another tool, and documents deprecations of the tools it targets. Installs from npm, a Homebrew tap or a single binary.
contains: generates config files from unified rule files for many AI coding tools
features: rules, ignore, MCP, commands, subagents, skills, hooks, permissions
imports and exports configuration between tools
installs via npm, Homebrew tap or single binary
deprecation notes track targets like Continue, Tabnine and Roo Code
